To damp the interarea oscillation, a damping controller for MTDC system is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the topology and control strategy of MTDC system is analyzed in this paper. Secondly, based on the frequency characteristics of interarea oscillation, a damping controller is designed for MTDC system, and a power spectral density (PSD) analysis method is proposed to choose the optimal converter to be the status of damping controller. Finally, the effectiveness of the controller proposed in this paper is validated through case study based on the simulation model established using DIgSILENT/PowerFactory.

articleTitle: Exploring new graphical passwords by graph set-colorings subject to constraint sets
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: For the purpose of producing more complex graphical passwords by means of smaller graphs having fewer numbers of vertices and edges for easily be remembered and difficultly be break down, we prove: (1) a tree T having n vertices has a strongly set-coloring subject to the constraint set of six restrict conditions; (2) a connected (p,q)-graph G has a strongly set-coloring subject to the constraint set of eight restrict conditions. The proof methods used in this article can be transferred into efficient algorithms.

articleTitle: An assessment method for measurement accuracy of gravity gradiometer
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Gravity gradient has a higher resolution than gravity, which makes it play an important role in the exploration of oil and mineral respecting. In order to obtain accurate information about gravity gradient, it is necessary to assess the performance of gravity gradiometer before the survey. In this paper, a new assessment method for measurement accuracy of gravity gradiometer is proposed for the drawbacks of the existing assessment methods, such as take long time, complex workload and spends high. The new assessment method is based on the assumption that the gravitational potential satisfies Laplace equation. From this property, we know that the sum of diagonal components of the gravity gradient tensor matrix is zero. On the other hand, the gravity gradient signals expressed in the local geographic frame (LGF) can be obtained by changing the measured attitude of the gravity gradiometer. Then by judging whether the sum of diagonal components of the measured gravity gradient tensor is zero, the assessment of the gradiometer can be achieved. A simulation experiment is designed and carried out, and the results show that the assessment method works well.

articleTitle: Resistor detection based on convolutional neural networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Resistor detection are mostly suffered from compact size and multiple interferences of environment. In this paper, a method for resistor detection was proposed, which combined selective search (SS), convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and support vector machine (SVM). Using improved selective search method to reduce the time of generating candidate regions; taking advantages of independent features extraction and autonomous learning of CNNs, and avoiding the process of complicated features extraction manually; fewer training samples and parameters are needed with this method. According to the parameter tuning and experiment validation, this method achieved a precision of 96.15% on testing dataset established by ourselves. In addition, this method is also applicable to the identification of other small components.

articleTitle: Connections between traditional coloring/labeliings and new set-coloring/labeliings on graphical passwords of communication
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: From investigating graphical passwords (NGPs), we define set-labellings and set-colorings (set-labelling/colorings) of networks/graphs, and define the new edge-colorings called adjacent 1-common edge-coloring and vertex 1-common edge-coloring. Some connections between traditional graph colorings and our set-labelling/colorings are found. Conversely, our results can be used to design more complicated NGPs such that our NGPs are possible in practice or real life. Several researching topics are presented for further working on NGPs and graph theory.

articleTitle: Evaluating the importance of CTO/CIO social networks in IT companies
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The importance of social networks has drawn the attention of researchers for many years. It is a hot topic in the research line of financial intelligence. Recently, researchers discovered that the network centrality of board members is an important indicator of a company. However, no previous studies focused on the relation of the company size and the centrality of CTO/CIO. Therefore, we presented a comparison of the network centrality of CTO/CIO for different company size in this paper. These network centralities included the PageRank, the triangle counting and the degree of centrality. We compared the Standard & Poor's top 100 companies with other companies. Experiments showed that, the social network sizes of CTO/CIOs in large companies are bigger than the social network sizes of CTO/CIO in small companies. Moreover, we discovered that the size of those social networks between CTO/CIO is a key factor of the difference of the company size. For example, the average PageRank value of CIO/CTO in large company was 60 times of the average PageRank value of CIO/CTO in small business. In addition, the triangle counting value of CIO/CTO in large companies was eight times of the triangle counting value of CIO/CTO in small businesses. Furthermore, the degree of centrality of CIO/CTO in large enterprises was twice as that of small businesses. Using real world database, this paper was promising for real world applications.

articleTitle: The modeling and simulation of supercharger control circuit based on the AMESim
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: According to the structural characteristics and working principle of the single action supercharger, the mathematical model is built and the static and dynamic characteristics are analysed. The AMESim model of supercharger control circuit is built and the dynamic simulation of pressure and flow rate is investigated. The simulation result shows that the model is rationality and feasible.

articleTitle: Design and simulation analysis of cam-type stepping drive manipulator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Stepping motion is the movement of output execution with fixed period of motion, and the cam type manipulator has the characteristics of steady movement, accurate transmission, controllable working speed and low cost. According to the output step action design 6 different types of cam mechanism(plane groove cam, cylindrical cam, globoidal cam mechanism with cylinder cam mechanism, plane groove cam-cylindrical cam, double globoidal cam, globoidal cam - plane groove cam) and compared. Taking the globoidal cam as an example, the program of the theoretical contour curve is compiled, and the solid modeling is completed by using CREO. Finally, the simulation analysis of double arc convex wheel stepping drive manipulator is carried out, and the displacement, velocity and acceleration curves of the actuator are obtained.

Author Keywords: Three dimensional modeling of Globoidal Cam

articleTitle: An improved congestion control algorithm based on social awareness in opportunistic networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In opportunistic networks, forwarding based protocols lead to a large amount of data flow to the highly connected nodes and unfairness of the nodes' traffic load, finally, it makes the highly connected nodes suffer congestion and results in the messages were discarded. To solve this problem, a congestion control algorithm based on Social Awareness is proposed in this paper. When choosing the next hop, it will consider the direct social relationship, indirect social relationship and the receiving capability as the transfer utility, then the message was transferred to the node which the transfer utility is high. Besides, the message which the utility value is the lowest will be dropped by comparing the utility value of its own messages when the receiving node congestion occurs. Experimental results show that the proposed method is superior to other methods in reducing the dropping rate of the message and improving the efficiency of data delivery.

articleTitle: Research on cutting quantity optimization based on CNC lathe
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the machining process, the rationalization of the cutting amount is an important way to effectively improve the productivity, reduce the cost and improve the quality of the workpiece. The rapid development of genetic algorithm has made remarkable achievements in solving the problem of nonlinear optimization. However, in the process of machining, there are many factors that affect the amount of cutting. The standard genetic algorithm is difficult to solve the problem quickly and accurately. In this paper, CNC lathe is used as the carrier, the optimization of the mathematical model of the cutting quantity is established, the optimization rules are analyzed, and the genetic optimization algorithm is used to solve the optimization problem of the cutting rate in the processing of the CNC lathe. The implementation method is illustrated by an example.

articleTitle: An improved fuzzy optimum selection model for choosing wavebreak forest species and its application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To solve the complexity and difficulty of tree species selection of wavebreak forest in a certain area effectively, an improved fuzzy optimum selection model (FOSM) using the tree species suitability multi-index system is proposed for wavebreak forest in flood control planning. And a new relative membership degree formula is introduced in the FOSM. Through the improved FOSM, the tree species recommended and not recommended could be optimized. The case study in Nenjiang River Basin shows that the proposed model is capable of selecting tree species for wavebreak forest and could provide useful information for the regional integrated planning and management of flood control.

articleTitle: Train number recognition algorithm based on two cameras
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The most critical technique in the train number detection process is the extraction and division of vehicle image. This paper introduces an intelligent detection system based on two cameras. First of all, on the basis of kalman prediction tracking algorithm, this paper puts forward a kind of collaborative tracking discriminant train number system, and determining the best Angle of the camera. To correct the collected images based on Hough transform and feature point projection., do binary processing according to a dynamic gray-level threshold of image, segment the image using local vertical projection method, intelligent matching the split character to the characters in the template library based on the Hamming short principle, and put forward a new method in the basis of that.

articleTitle: An innovative RSA scheme in multi-domain heterogeneous software
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Optical Wavelength Division Multiplexing (WDM) networks based on fixed grid technology have exposed some questions, including wasting of bandwidth resources in multi-domain heterogeneous networks. Flexible grid technologies can provide end-to-end optical path according to the client flexibly and effectively. However, it is unpractical to deploy a one-time green-field flexible grid technologies subjected to some practical purposes, such as the existing and well developed fixed grid optical networks need to be preserved. For both of transmission technologies, the problems of Physical Layer Impairments (PLIs) and energy consumption are two categories that are not to be sneezed at. In this paper, we propose an effective hierarchical control scheme to effectively utilizing resource of multi-domain heterogeneous network, then we emphatically design Routing and Spectrum Assignment (RSA) algorithm bundle. The simulation results verified the effectiveness of idea that the proposed algorithm bundle can ensure network Quality-of-Service (QoS) by reducing overall network blocking probability and energy consumption.

articleTitle: Intelligent manor sand table demo system based on Internet of things and virtual reality technology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Combined with popular Internet of things and virtual reality technology, this paper has developed a set of intelligent agriculture, intelligent home in one of the intelligent manor sand table demo system. System test shows that the system can effectively simulate a number of intelligent agriculture, intelligent home in the practical scene. In the intelligent agricultural system part of the use of wireless network sensors to collect crop growth environment information, in the intelligent home system part can be achieved on the manor gate, street lamps and other control. The system can establish a 3D virtual model based on the solid model of sand table. It can not only provide professional demo tools such as computer application technology and Internet of things Engineering, but also provide model templates and hardware and software support for creating real intelligent manor.

articleTitle: Simulation and analysis on the influence of under excitation limiter for control strategies of HVDC sending grid
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: At present, because the accuracy of the model and its parameters of Under Excitation Limiter (UEL) for generators in power system stability simulation in China is insufficient, power factor depth of the generators during the simulation evidently is different from the capability of generators, the check of steady voltage rise will be optimistic and the pre-control strategies based on these results are inaccurate. In this paper, at first the model of under excitation limiter based on the mainstream automatic excitation regulator is established; then the impacts of this model on steady voltage rise and pre-strategies of Tianzhong HVDC sending grid are analyzed by simulation, which point out that the check of serious faults in power system stability simulation should consider the UEL; finally, the setting method of UEL curve for improving the capability of power factor depth is proposed, which have been applied on the generators near the Tianzhong HVDC sending grid, the availability of this method is verified.

articleTitle: Design and testing of an apple grading control system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to improve the elïïciency of apple's grading and ensure the scientilïcity and objectivity of grading, this paper presents a three-stage grading system, namely weighing grading, color grading and shape grading. Hardware design uses high-performance S3C2440 embedded controller, DSP controller, single-chip micro-processor controller, pressure load sensor, color recognition sensor, graphic recognition sensor and motor. Software design includes the realization of apple weighing DSP monitoring procedures, color grading SCM C51 procedures and shape grading embedded system procedures. Test results show that the maximum relative error of single stage is 5.6%; therefore system can fully meet the practical demands of apple grading.

articleTitle: Optimization method for the planning and design of residential district based on the simulation analysis of atmospheric flow field
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the accelerated urbanization process in China, more and more attention has been paid to residential environment quality. How to improve atmospheric quality, accelerate pollutant emission and reduce resource consumption by rationalizing layout is one of the most important issues in developing a healthy community. Based on the method of fluent flow field simulation, this paper chooses and analyzes a numerical model that dynamically maps to the changes in atmospheric flow field. Then by use of computer simulation technology, an intuitive analysis of the “vortex zone” and “cavity zone” in the atmospheric flow field of residential district is given in this paper. By adjusting and optimizing the layout, this paper makes the atmospheric flow field of the residential district present the optimized normal distribution both in summer and winter, thus reaching the goal of enhancing the comfort of the community, saving energy and reducing emission.

articleTitle: A posture data equivalent alternative method on space tracking ship
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The difïerence of Inertia navigation device distribution between traditional space TT&C ship and new space TT&C ship is discussed. Since the design for Inertia navigation device distribution can affect observation mode and ship posture data usage, ship posture alternative problem is raised base on the analysis of space TT&C ship's design. The problem is conversed to a universal 2 point posture alternative problem. The equivalent posture matrix at fault point is obtained, through two equivalent coordinate transformation processes. Then posture data at fault point is obtained by solving equations. At last, the alternative method is tested by using space TT&C ship's flight check data.

articleTitle: Community detection algorithm with locally social spider optimized
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Community detection in complex networks is very important for decision-making in the real world. Swarm intelligence optimization is an effective method for community detection. However, such algorithms are easy to fall into local optima and tend to ignore smaller communities. This paper proposed a community detection algorithm with locally social spider optimized (LSSO/CD). The network nodes and their relationships are initialized as spider populations, and the populations evolve by females and males respectively. The fitness function is defined by the degree of close connection among nodes, and the modular increment of community is used as the criterion of evolution. The whole process starts from a variety of local groups and the network is divided step by step. The results show that LSSO/CD can effectively balance global and local convergence, and solve complex network partition problem very well.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of an adjustable electromechanical actuator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In order to make the electromechanical actuator have the ability to adapt to the irregular installation space of high speed aircraft and the great dynamic characteristics, an adjustable actuator based on slider-crank structure was proposed and its transmission characteristics were studied. Firstly, the uniform nonlinear transmission ratio model is obtained respectively by applying speed synthesis theory and structure force balance theory. Secondly, the optimal layout of best symmetry is obtained by mathematical analysis. Then, the computer aided model was established, and the correctness of the nonlinear model was verified. Finally, the dynamic properties of the structure forms are simulated using MATLAB software, and compared with the existing fork structure and rocker arm structure. The simulation results show that, the actuator with slider-crank structure has great dynamic performance and strong adaptability to space, which is even more suitable for the requirements of high speed aircraft.

articleTitle: Optimal layout pattern of anti-wave forest based on improved fuzzy entropy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: To maximize the efficiency of wave attenuation of anti-wave forest with low cost, a multi-objective optimal layout selection model using improved fuzzy entropy was proposed. A new entropy weight calculation formula was introduced in the fuzzy entropy to improve the reliability of entropy weight. The effect of each vegetation factor was quantified and analyzed. The law of wave attenuation was revealed before selection. A case study conducted in the midstream of Nenjiang River Basin shows that the proposed model is applicable of selecting layout scheme of anti-wave forest and is useful for other multi-objective decision-making models.

articleTitle: Review-vane type Magneto-rheological damper
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Very less research is conducted on limited angle Magnetorheological (MR) damper compare to continuous angle Magnetorheological dampers. Despite of fact that limited angle MR damper cannot rotate continuously but can have ability to produce more damping torque than continuous angle MR dampers. There can be several applications of vane type MR dampers on which research can be conducted for example in automobile seat suspension, in airplane, in buildings and bridges etc. In this paper, an overview of recent advances in limited angle MR damper are presented, in terms of different structural design, magnetic circuit configuration, modelling techniques and ease of maintenance. The review separates the difference in design of different type of vane type MR dampers with arc valve, with outer coil valve and with inner coil valve. Problems concerned to ease of manufacturing, maintenance, leakages, structure and shape particularly highlighted.

Author Keywords: classifications of Vane type MR dampers

articleTitle: Research on medical data mining technology
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Big data and cloud platform technology continue to develop, making the rapid development of the medical industry, the level of medical electronic higher and higher. Thus, medical data is also more rich mode, incomplete, timing, redundancy characteristics. However, the scientific use of medical data is critical to medical outcomes. In this paper, the characteristics of medical data, the current hotspot medical data mining technology research theory, basic model, algorithm, process steps and key points, research direction and make a general summary. This article paves the way for further research in this field, and also makes popularization for the research of this direction.

articleTitle: The analysis of influence factors of impedance in inductively coupled plasma
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Inductively coupled plasma (ICP) has become the most common ion source in analytical instruments. The characteristics of the plasma impedance, which are key parameters of the stability and efficiency of analytical instruments, can be easily influenced by the working environments. Therefore, there is an urgent need to investigate the impedance properties of the plasma. In this work, firstly, the ICP equivalent circuit model was established by combining the transformer model and the matching network model. Secondly, the expression of the ICP impedance were obtained by calculation. Finally, by changing the experimental conditions during ICP operation, the relationships between the plasma impedance and carrier gas, the cooling gas and the power were obtained, respectively. The results show that the impedance value of the inductively coupled plasma is very low, changing from 0.5Ω to 1.5Ω. In addition, the plasma impedance increases with the flow rate of the carrier gas, while, the plasma impedance decreases with the input power increases. And the impedance of the plasma was not influenced by the flow rate of the cooling gas.

articleTitle: Finite element model updating based on sensitivity analysis for 5-DOF manipulator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Multi-degree of freedom manipulators have become a hotspot in the field of robotics because of many advantages. In this paper, a 5-DOF manipulator was taken as the object of study. The modal analysis on it was carried out by methods of test and finite element analysis. A model updating method based on sensitivity analysis was put forward, and the final finite element model was established by iterative optimization. By means of correlation analysis and MAC modal judgment criterion, it was verified that the simulation results of the final simulation model of the manipulator have a good correlation with the experimental modal results. The finite element model determined by this method accurately reflected the actual structural dynamic characteristics of the manipulator.

articleTitle: Expressway ET interconnection based on Internet of Things communication middleware
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper briefly introduces the technology of expressway emergency telephone system and internet communication middleware, and introduces the technology of using the Internet of things middleware technology to realize the interconnection of expressway emergency telephone system.

articleTitle: A design of power quality analysis and monitoring circuit for high power motor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: After a brief introduction to the concept and classification of power quality problems in power supply network, this paper focuses on the test and analysis methods of several common power quality problems. Finally, a power quality monitoring circuit is designed for a high power motor power supply network.

articleTitle: The multi-attribute group decision making in the police station evaluation system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The aim of the paper mainly study to group decision making problem in the police station performance evaluation system by utilizing interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy soft set based on operations. In the process of the decision making, we fully consider the importance of each expert according to their knowledge background. Firstly, we introduce an interval-valued intuitionistic fuzzy soft set and their properties and operations. According to the idea of operators to aggregate the thought of different experts, and successfully apply to the mid-level soft set of intuitionistic fuzzy soft set, which confirm that "membership levels" and "non-membership levels" are entirely considered as the threshold to judge some of parameters whether can be considered as an important basis of evaluation of the final alternatives. Secondly, we apply weights of attributes in choice value of candidates to evaluate the alternatives. Finally, the paper shows a comparison with other group decision-making approach to demonstrate the accuracy and perfection of obtained result.

articleTitle: Error distribution estimation based weighted least square estimation for service robot hand-eye calibration
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Accurate hand-eye calibration is a very significant task in robotics. Many algorithms focus on L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> optimization, and Least Square Estimation (LSE) is usually employed to deal with this problem. For the reason that LSE can only be applied to occasions that errors obey normal distribution, LSE can lead to a lower precision of calibration result when gross errors occur. Different from the existing approaches, this paper introduces an error distribution estimation based weighted LSE for hand-eye calibration task. Firstly, transformation matrix is computed by traditional LSE. Error distribution is estimated on the basis of Gaussian kernel density estimation. Each data is weighted according to the density estimation and the fine result can be conducted by the weighted data. To evaluate the proposed method, an experiment was designed and the test result demonstrates the robustness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Visual tracking via spatio-temporal context learning using multi-templates
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Probabilistic tracking algorithms typically using linear structure to update the learning model. Such linear structure is not appropriate for long-term robust tracking as the occlusion and other challenging factors may interfere the processing of incoming frames. Recently a spatio-temporal context (STC) algorithm based on Bayesian framework has using the context information between the target and its locally contexts to help tracking. In this paper, we propose an adaptive structure model that can help to discard the negative information during the tracking. This model establishes multi-templates to hold the credible information while tracking, when one of the templates gets the better confidence coefficient, this template will replace the current template and update the learning model. Furthermore, an improved scale update scheme is proposed to handle the scale variations problems in STC. Extensive experimental results show that our tracker's superior robustness and accuracy against the original STC algorithm.

articleTitle: An algorithm of reconstructing LiDAR building models based on isoheight
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of complex roof reconstruction in airborne LiDAR data processing, an algorithm of reconstructing building models based on isoheight is proposed in this paper. Extracting points in the elevation scopes and fitting contours in different elevation, the key points of the roof models can be got. By the key points, we can get roof planes intersecting lines approximately. Through the intersecting lines and isoheights, the points can be clustered to different point sets and different roof planes are reconstructed. Finally, the reconstructed planes are combined and the building roof models are obtained. The simulations are based on different kinds of building roofs, results prove that the algorithm can be used to reconstruct different kinds of building roof models of airborne LiDAR.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy of microgrid with distributed PV and air source heat pumps
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The microgrid with distributed PV and air source heat pump is studied, aim at the problem of controller saturation caused by the lag of the static switch and the mismatch between the operation mode and the control method, droop control is used in island mode and grid-connected mode, an improved pre-synchronization control algorithm is proposed to ensure the smooth transition of the microgrid transient in this paper. The simulation of the microgrid switching from the island mode to grid-connected mode shows that the improved pre-synchronization control strategy reduced the impact on microgrid and the main grid in grid-connected operation, and then the microgrid can be smoothly connected to the main grid; the simulation of the microgrid switching from the grid-connected mode to island mode shows that the microgrid inverter based on droop control can quickly get the information from the grid to ensure the microgrid operate normally and effectively when the fault appear in the grid.

articleTitle: A method for load-spectrum acquisition of transmission gear based on measured data of vehicle proving ground
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Acquirement of load spectrum is an important premise for predicting the fatigue life of transmission gear. Traditional methods to acquire load spectrum including theoretical calculation, bench test and simulation test can't reflect the actual loading condition. This paper extracts the load data under different gears based on vehicle proving ground test without the signal of gear change and describes a method for extrapolation and statistics of load data. Discrete load spectrum used for fatigue life analysis can be obtained at last.

articleTitle: A new prediction unscented Kalman filter based on robust model and its application
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the increase of state dimension, the calculation of UKF algorithm increases rapidly, and UKF is more sensitive to model error, and it is not suitable for the system model with noise as non-Gaussian distribution. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a robust model predictive Unscented Kalman filter based on the study of robust estimation, model predictive filtering and UKF. The algorithm uses the expansion method to add the driving noise to the system state, which increases the state information of the system. The model predictive filter (MPF) is used to suppress the model error, and the robustness of the system is improved by using the robust estimation. The algorithm is sensitive to the error of the model. The proposed algorithm is applied to the SINS / BNTS / CNS integrated navigation system and compared with the adaptive EKF and the robust adaptive UKF algorithm. The results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively suppress the position error and velocity error, the filtering performance Significantly better than adaptive EKF and robust adaptive UKF.

articleTitle: Type-z0g3 controller of output tracking for fractional power system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Because most systems are nonlinear in practical applications, output tracking for nonlinear system is of great interest to engineers and scientists. As a specific class of nonlinear system, fractional power system arises in many problems, yet little progress is made on this topic. Inspired by Zhang et al., this paper presents a simple but powerful method of controller design, i.e., generating the controller via gradient dynamics (GD), yielding a type-z0g3 tracking controller in the framework of Zhang-gradient (ZG) method. The superiority of this method lies in clear design procedure. Additionally, three simulation examples are presented to substantiate the feasibility and effectiveness of z0g3 controller for tracking control of the fractional power system.

articleTitle: A modal analysis for vehicle's crankshaft
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: It is very important to analyze the dynamic characteristics for the crankshaft during the working process. By use of ANSYS software of finite element model of the crankshaft modal analysis to get the top 20 order natural frequency and the corresponding vibration mode, and put forward the possible resonance risk and design concerns. It has some guiding significance for the design and manufacture of heavy-duty car brake drum.

articleTitle: Risk assessment for distribution systems based on key performance indicator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Based on the deficiencies for risk indicators of fault probability and consequence's application in distribution systems, the strategy of risk assessment for system operation based on health and importance indices is proposed. The health index oriented to system running states and importance index geared to the user diversity are defined, by comprehensively thinking about the development situation of distribution network and distinction of consumer requirements for the power service reliability. Moreover, the rules for selecting health and importance levels under influences of different risk sources, together with the combination assignments method for weighting are elaborately analyzed, in order to contribute for the risk assessment architecture model establishment. In addition, corresponding risk assessment software platform on the theoretical basis of health and importance indices are explored, to realize functions of real time perception, risk evaluation and warning in the distribution system for practical engineering projects. Finally, an actual 59-node system have been chosen for demonstration experiments, and it can be aware that the risk states are seasonably reflected by test results with specific time section information, furthermore prevention control actions are automatically taken in alert risk condition to enhance the security operation and power supply dependability, which testify the correctness and feasibility of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of temperature field and stress field coupling for pistons in engines
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The stress and displacement fields of a piston are calculated with temperature-structure field coupling by The finite element software ANSYS, Contact boundary conditions are employed in using FEM software ANSYS, the results can be provided a reference for improving the design.

articleTitle: A relevant casual relation based timestamp order consistency control method in DVE systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In DVE systems, maintaining the consistency of event execution time is the core element to provide a unified view for all nodes in the system. However, owing to the fluctuation of message transmission delay within the network, some events cannot be executed at the expected time set by the sending node., It will seriously impact the interactive experience of the user in the virtual environment, especially when there is a disorder between the events with causal relationship. In this paper, we propose a new timestamp consistency control method based on relevant causal relations between events. By introducing a relevant cause-effect event detection mechanism in the traditional timestamp consistency control method, it is ensured that events with causality can be processed in the correct order. The experimental results show that the proposed method can greatly reduce the probability of occurrence of causal violation, and improve the usability of the virtual environment system.

articleTitle: A fault detection method for complex electromechanical system using improved integrated approach
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In view of certain limitations to applications of conventional multivariate statistical methods under increasingly complicated industrial process system, this paper proposes a fault detection method for complex electromechanical system using ILLE-SVDD data dimensionality reduction. The method combines traditional ILLE and SVDD. First of all, sample points in the original high-dimensional space are linearly represented with their adjacent points' Euclidean distance, using locally linear embedding (LLE). Build a local reconstruction relationship matrix and keep its reconstruction relationship unchanged as far as possible in low-dimensional space, to reduce dimensionality. Secondly, by containing most of the samples in space within the space of sphere, separate a few exceptional samples outside the sphere, to detect exceptions and classify. Finally, in the process of TE, carry out a simulation experiment. Results show that ILLE has a better manifold unfolding effect. SVDD can detect exceptions effectively and is easier to implement in application.

articleTitle: Research of forging handling robot mechanism based on hybrid structure
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The forging handling robot is one of the key pieces of equipment in the integrated forging operation unit. The robot is characterized by heavy loading ability, high velocity and high positioning accuracy. According to these characteristics, this work proposes a new scheme for the hybrid structure. The scheme can complete 5-DOF motion, which contains body rotation, clamp expansion, clamp lifting, clamp rotation and clamp gripping. The main movement body is a type of hybrid mechanism that is composed of three groups of parallelogram mechanisms, driven by three groups of hydraulic cylinders in parallel. This scheme can effectively extend the working space of the robot and more reasonably allocate the load to allow easier control. Kinematic model was established at the end of the robot gripper for linear motion based on the sine curve, the change curves of the displacement of each hydraulic cylinder using MATLAB. The correctness of the model and the rationale of the mechanisms were verified. The scheme provides a reference for the design of the forging handling robot mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on the reasonable investment scale measurement of power grid based on the reform of transmission and distribution price
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: With the gradual advance of transmission and distribution price reform, the operating mode and profit model of power grid enterprises will be completely changed. By strengthening the supervision of transmission and distribution costs of power grid enterprises, the government has mobilized the power grid to reduce operating costs and improve the quality of customer service. At the same time, it also puts forward higher requirements for the investment planning of power grid enterprises, under the supervision of the government, it is necessary to fulfill more social responsibilities and ensure the profitability of power grid enterprises. This paper firstly introduces the transmission and distribution price regulation and verification method, it also analyzes the influence of transmission and distribution price reform on power grid enterprises. Through the sale of electricity, transmission and distribution price constraints, which can determine the minimum new investment scale and the largest investment scale so as to determine a reasonable range of new investment. The reasonable new investment scale estimation model in this paper will play a guiding role in the investment planning for power grid.

articleTitle: Grid information management innovation of government in the era of big data
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In recent years, with development and wide application of information technology, the amount of valuable data explosively increases, leading the arrival of the big data. Grid management with the advantages of informatization, rapidity and high efficiency, has become a form of government management innovation practice in China. Grid information management has broad prospects and will affect all aspects of government management in the era of big data. The inherent demand of China's social development is to use the big data to strengthen and innovate the government management and to improve the government management level. One of the real footholds of this demand is to build a grid government information management system. Therefore, this article suggests that China should promote grid information management continually, build a grid information management system with science and technology. To promote the diversification of government management by establishing an independent grid information coordinating and management organization. And to improve the government management level by strengthening the capacity-building of grid information management team.

articleTitle: Research on UAV reconnoitering the topology structure of field communication network based on traversal algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Field Communication Network is a complex communication network system with grid topology structure, so it is difficult to disable communication. The paper puts forward a strategy to search the topology structure using UAV. At first, the paper analyzes the characteristics of node center in Field Communication Network, combining with the direction-finding and localization ability of UAV, proving that UAV can obtain all the adjacent nodes of goal node by reconnoitering while flying around the goal node. Through studying graph theory and DFS algorithm, the paper puts forward a traversal algorithm that can obtain all the node center and the wireless links of Field Communication Network. At last, the paper proves the feasibility of the algorithm through an example.

articleTitle: Research on autonomous control model for federation of HM&E system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: HaW Mechanical & Electrical (HM&E) System provide services to the ships which are vital to completing its mission, such as water, electric power, oil and mobility. Because mostly system based on "man in loop" traditional mode to control, it need more personnel requirement and run cost. Therefore, combined with the feature of surface warship HM&E system physical model, a layered modeling method and an autonomous control model for HM&E system is proposed to change traditional man control from to autonomous running. The simulation results have shown that HM&E system could have adaptive reconstruction and autonomous execution ability in unmanned condition of normal, fault and damage by this model, effectively improve automation level and overall vitality for ship platform.

articleTitle: Indirect control and design of insect-like flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Considering the Insect-like flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle, this paper has analyzed the composite of quasi-steady aerodynamics. That process has associated with the affection due to addition quality produced by wake capture. With introducing rotate circulation. This paper has calculated the lift, drag force, and pitch torque which take part on the wings' surfaces. Ignoring the wings' quality, the aircraft could be viewed as a rigid body. According to the Newton-Euler principle, establishing the dynamics model of aircraft is realized. And then, this paper has accomplished the indirect Adaptive controller and the update rate law. The algorithm could give dynamic compensation on uncertainty of the system. At last, this paper has taken the simulation of the algorithm. The result of that has verified the effectiveness of the controller design.

articleTitle: On magic matching sets having many magic parameters in information networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Graphical passwords have been proposed as a possible alternative to text-based schemes, but graphical passwords, in storage and communication, require much more storage space than text based passwords, and network transfer delay is also a concern for them. An idea of "graphical structure plus number theory" (GSPNT) for designing new type of passwords is an alternative to typical graphical passwords. Magic matching set having many magic parameters is one of graphical passwords produced by GSPNT. Some results on magic matching sets are obtained and interesting problems are proposed at the end of this article.

articleTitle: Research on generalized sidelobe canceller based on modified wavelet threshold function
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the microphone array speech enhancement, The coherent noise has a great influence on the accuracy and speech leakage of the delay estimation in the beamforming algorithm. In this paper, the wavelet threshold denoising method is effectively combined with the beamforming algorithm to acting on every signal of microphone array. It can eliminate coherent noise in the signal to reduce noise-induced delay errors and leakage. In the wavelet threshold denoising algorithm, the threshold function directly determines the enhancement effect. So in this paper, we propose an improved continuous threshold function with adjustment parameters and the wavelet coefficients of speech signal with noisy could be processed in the wavelet domain. Speech signal after being eliminate can be obtained through reconstructing. The adaptive beamformer of the generalized sidelobe canceller uses the improved LMS algorithm to speed up the updating speed of the weight coefficient. The simulation results show that compared with the traditional generalized sidelobe canceller, the proposed algorithm improves the signal-to-noise ratio and intelligibility of the speech signal.

articleTitle: Identifying influential nodes in large-scale software networks
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The protection of important nodes in Large-scale software network has been the focus of software engineering. Large-scale software network is a kind of complex network, therefore, we can identify influential nodes in large-scale software networks in the view of complex networks. This paper proposes a method for measure the importance of nodes based on the duplicato-degree and the neighbor clustering coefficient. Five networks are introduced to validate the proposed approach. To evaluate the performance of the new method, the top twenty percent of nodes in five networks are removed one by one from the networks according to the importance ranking lists produced by the new method. Then calculate the number of sub networks after splitting the entire network. The result indicate that the new method can be used to measure the importance of nodes and the effect is significant.

articleTitle: Realization and application of spindle and C-axis switching function based on PMAC
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: In the process of multi axis machine tool, sometimes it is necessary to switch between the rotating spindle and the rotary feed shaft. In order to satisfy the request mentioned above, this article makes a brief introduction to the upper software and analyzes the control principle of spindle by using PMAC, combined with that, a method to deliver the automatic switching function between spindle mode and C-axis mode has been put forward, which has already used in the independent R&D project single-point diamond ultra-precision CNC system. In addition, on the basis of this method, a more advanced function called constant linear speed mode will be explored, which can both ensure the quality of workpiece and improving efficiency enormously.

articleTitle: Research on control method of hybrid two-phase stepping motor based on adaptive fuzzy
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This article analyzed the limitation of stepping motor in current application. The model of hybrid two-phase stepping motor is established. A control system based on fuzzy adaptive control method is designed, and the effectiveness of this method is proved by practical test. The results show that the overshoot of the fuzzy adaptive control is about 5.2% and the adjustment time is about 100 ms.

articleTitle: Design and rigid-flexible coupling dynamic analysis of cam-type ATC manipulator
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The cam-type ATC manipulator has the advantages of fast tool changing and high efficiency, but the structure is complex and difficult to design. This paper proposed a new method of globoid cam 3D modeling for ATC manipulator-double-globoid cam mechanism, which could solve the design problem of the cam-type ATC device. Then, the multi-ridge dynamics model of the cam-type ATC manipulator was established; the key components were flexed by ANSYS, and the rigid-flexible coupling dynamics virtual prototype was established, the performance of the rigid-flexible coupling model was analyzed, and the analyzed results was compared with the results of the multi-rigid model through ADMAS. The analysis process was as much as possible to simulate the situation of the ATC mechanism in actual work process. And the result has a reference value to establish and analyze rigid-flexible coupling model of ATC mechanism in the future.

articleTitle: An optimization model for resilient service systems
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: The best service systems aren't just cost-effective. They also respond quickly, handle smoothly and recover promptly from disruptions. This paper proposes a linear piece-wise recovery function and applies it to the decision-making processes of improving a service system's resilience to disasters. A numeric example is developed to demonstrate the proposed model enables tradeoff between a cost minimum system and a resilient system.

articleTitle: The design and application of functional reactive distributed process control system
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: Process monitoring and controlling system is essentially a data monitoring event transmission system, they are usually developed based on the procedure languange C with high cost and in low maintainability. functional reactive programming is a time-saving, bug-preventing programming paradigm worthy of control system to implement. In this paper the implementing the new kind of functional reactive programming based on combination Bacon.js, Node.js, Kafka and AngularJS in the real hot-heating supplying automatic controlling system is elaborated. In this system the functional reactive approach has been pushing both on the back-end and the front-end to simplifie controlling system desing and programming and reduce the development lifecycle.

articleTitle: Indoor 3D path planning using a Kinect V2 sensor
publicationTitle: 2017 IEEE 3rd Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an indoor three-dimensional path planning system for the automatic control of robots using a Kinect V2 sensor. In the method, a RGBD SLAM system using Kinect V2 sensor is introduced to identity the environment and obtain the indoor three-dimensional map. At the same time, the rapidly exploring random tree (RRT) is used for a safe and optimal navigation of robot in three-dimensional space. We also propose one variation of the RRT to addresses the optimization problem of traditional RRT. In the end, the experiments are conducted with robot operating system (ROS), and a 3D map that can be directly used for navigation of robots is created. The traditional RRT path planning method and the improved RRT method are also presented based on the 3D map.
